description: Shared base of the end-to-end Neuralese stage for both lines (owner decision 2026-10-12: start the E2E arm now, in parallel with SFT; plans/REVIEW_20261012.md item 2; design plans/neuralese/NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "End-to-end stage"). It starts from a direct export (a neuralese_direct checkpoint exported by train/direct_export.py) bound as input_bindings.direct_artifact by the launch recipe that extends a line recipe; that binding is a lineage key, not a parity setting. Two stages: direct_runtime runs the exact runtime qualification of that export on the stage's machine (eval/direct_runtime.py: writer, cache readback, producer replay and input adjoints, typed wire); e2e trains train/trajectories.py --direct-artifact on all of the e2e corpus neuralese-e2e-cohort-20261012-v2 (174,608 records in 24,141 whole trajectories, 158,936 trainable train-split records, 85,315 train edges; registered, scripts/neuralese_data/e2e_mine.py), streamed one trajectory at a time (--record-source trajectories, train/e2e_records.py, dgx-a256 2026-10-13): each drawn chain is read by offset and authenticated on its own, families are drawn by trainable-record count^0.5 through the shared CohortDocumentSampler (musique_hops, 42% of the records, gets 14%), 4 held chains and 1 probe chain per family load at start, steps = one epoch of the trainable train records at batch 1, and instructions pieces are their text (--soft-parts text, as the direct stage trained and the runtime serves; 3139 pieces would otherwise be single-use trained soft prompts): producers write their child results with the shared direct writer (token-driven, one Neuralese value per crisp token, generated-length stops), consumers read the written block, the identity TokenChoiceProjection comes on at step 0 (logits equal the export's), the backbone latents train on MuonSR (cubic5, wd 0.1, spike clip 5) and step inside the layer-staged backward, with the shared drift monitor (response KL warns 0.5, stops 1.5; the 48-probe behaviour gate is reported only, owner 2026-10-12) and the line's QAT component held at its parent's curriculum progress. Acceptance (e2e_acceptance, train/e2e_acceptance.py, written as e2e-certificate.json): consumers reading values against consumers reading the gold tokens on the same held producer calls (V CE at most T CE; V beats shuffled and zeroed blocks by 0.05 nats; at least 32 paired readers), exact-oracle task success (V at most 0.02 below T), and no drift stop. Lines: neuralese-e2e-mellum-v1 (DGX), neuralese-e2e-lfm-v1 (Pop); every difference is declared in training/neuralese/line-parity.json.

projection_on_manifold.description: Owner 2026-10-13: the NeuraleseProjection value E[chosen] + C(h), made on the exact parent export as the first step of the e2e handoff (train/projection_align.py init), is on the token-embedding manifold before any e2e update. Held positions of the line's own union text data (test split): nearest-token accuracy and cosine to E[chosen] (the readout's argmax), and the mean functional KL of the backbone reading a held span as values instead of E[chosen] embeddings (NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "The Neuralese value", "Projection alignment fit (2026-10-13)"). Applied by the direct_runtime stage (eval/direct_runtime.py) with train/e2e_acceptance.projection_on_manifold.

quantization.description: Shared QAT of the end-to-end stage (owner: QAT in every stage, light on LFM; lockstep of both lines): the direct base's q4 point (int4 g32), held at its parent's curriculum progress. After the full direct lineage (direct_sft [0, 0.75], direct_trajectory [0.75, 1.0]) that is 1.0, so q4 is at lambda 1 and sampled at weight 0.5 beside BF16. A launch from a mid-lineage snapshot holds the snapshot's progress instead (its launch recipe overrides stage_progress.e2e). Lines add points only where the backbone deploys lower (Mellum). The nested family is not trained in e2e yet (gap, both lines).

e2e_acceptance.description: NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "End-to-end stage" section 4 and its resolved margins; T reads the gold crisp text (teacher-oracle reference); the greedy-T arm, the token-readout regression (eval/direct_token_readout.py) and the behaviour gate are reported. Task success is the shared in-run evaluation (eval/task_cadence.py, the direct stage's 16-case held subset): V against T on cases with a fused hand-off (pending until held tasks have model-to-model hand-offs), and the final weights against the parent's (task_eval-init) on the text transport.
